Hello there, I would like to request my character Saphru the unholy angel. I would like the image to be square. I would like the image to be bust up as well, please. I would like the angle to be the last image I put in the references, feel free to change it if you do not feel it will fit, I am open to letting you choose the entire pose. I would like her expression to be cold and stoic. I really love how you draw eyes, so I would like to see at least one in the picture. I would like there to be different crystals incorporated into the image, like quartz, smoky quartz, amethyst. I will let you choose which ones you would like to add, but I would like the gems to be raw and uncut. I linked an album cover from an artist that i've liked for quite a long time that has a similar idea as to what I mean. I would like the image to be light and have an ethereal feeling to it. If it isn't too much trouble could you provide a separate version without her horns , halo and chains. If you do not want to draw a second one it's okay I don't mind. Thank you for reading my request, I look forward to working with you.
